_doc: Monster camps (scripts/match/camps.gd, docs/decisions/0048-camps-and-xp.md). kind_size: a map camp spot's layout kind -> its size. sizes, smallest first (the hot zone and a comeback are the next one up): name (player text), n monsters, big (the one big monster: the region's version of it), armor (the bundle's armor), orb (chance 0..1 of a perk orb, source 'camp'), gear (if set: one gear piece, this many rarity steps over the region's), big_rar (rarity steps over its roll for the big one). small: the small kinds when a camp has no region table. A camp's XP is the sum of its monsters (content/rules/xp.json). back_s: a cleared camp comes back once, this long after its clear (s), if no Hunter is within back_clear_r (m) and the spot is safe for back_safe_s (s); none after back_until_s (match s). max_mobs: camp monsters alive at once. spread (m): how far monsters stand from the camp's centre. bots (scripts/match/bot_camps.gd): crown_pick, the chance a bot leader tries the Crown first (one bot squad a match at most); stop_s, bot squads stop clearing their region at this match time (s); safe_s (s) and blight_r (m), they stop too when the spot is not safe that long or the Blight is that near; rival_r (m), a camp with a squad of more total levels this close is skipped; together_r (m), a squadmate further than this from the squad's leader walks to it; detour_lvl, after stop_s a squad whose best Hunter is below this level goes to a camp within detour_r (m). glide_k, a bot squad pings only a camp within this share of the canopy's glide after the launch's dive from where the ship lets it jump (the ship's ride ends before its run does).
